payload.name: The Showcase Vault
payload.description: A test dungeon with every kind of door, transition, and feature.

areas.name: Entry hall
areas.description: Dust lies thick on a floor of cracked flagstones. An offering bowl rests on a plinth.

features.description: A bronze bowl of old coins.

areas.name: Secret closet
areas.description: A narrow space behind the wall, stacked with forgotten crates.

areas.name: Guard post
areas.description: Bunks of rotten timber line the walls. A loose stone sits in the floor.

areas.name: Shrine of the hollow god
areas.description: A black altar stands under a vaulted ceiling. Its basin holds a hoard.

areas.name: Pillared hall
areas.description: Rows of fluted pillars hold up a sagging roof. Some flagstones are hollow.

areas.name: Stair chamber
areas.description: Worn steps spiral down into the dark.

areas.name: Hidden grotto
areas.description: Water drips into a still pool.

features.description: A face carved in the wall.

areas.name: Landing
areas.description: The stairs end in a round chamber.

areas.name: Pit cell
areas.description: A cell with no door handle on the inside.
